benefits.name: Health insurance
benefits.def: Employer-funded medical cover. The largest non-salary line in US postings; elsewhere it usually tops up public cover.

benefits.name: Dental cover
benefits.def: Dental treatment paid or subsidised by the employer, usually bundled with medical cover.

benefits.name: Vision cover
benefits.def: Eye tests and glasses paid or subsidised, usually bundled with medical and dental.
benefits.unless_near: (computer vision|machine vision|vision system|product vision|company vision|our vision|vision and mission)

benefits.name: Mental health support
benefits.def: Counselling, therapy sessions, or a subscribed service such as Headspace or Spill.

benefits.name: Life insurance
benefits.def: A death-in-service payout to a nominated beneficiary, typically a multiple of salary.

benefits.name: Disability cover
benefits.def: Income protection if illness or injury stops you working, short or long term.

benefits.name: Wellness stipend
benefits.def: A recurring allowance for gym, fitness, or wellbeing spending, paid whether or not you use a specific provider.

benefits.name: Health checks
benefits.def: Employer-paid screening: annual physicals, eye tests for screen users, or on-site clinics.

benefits.name: Retirement match
benefits.def: The employer pays into your retirement account on top of your own contribution. The match rate is the number that matters.

benefits.def: Variable pay on top of salary: annual, performance, or company-wide.

benefits.name: Signing bonus
benefits.def: A one-off payment for joining, sometimes tied to staying a minimum term.

benefits.name: Commission
benefits.def: Pay tied to what you sell or close, on top of base salary.

benefits.name: Tuition support
benefits.def: The employer pays toward a degree, certification, or course fees.

benefits.name: Relocation support
benefits.def: Money or logistics for moving to the job's location.

benefits.name: Commuter benefit
benefits.def: A transit pass, parking, mileage, or a cycle-to-work scheme.

benefits.name: Home-office budget
benefits.def: A one-off or recurring allowance for the desk, chair, and hardware you work from.

benefits.name: Meals covered
benefits.def: Free or subsidised food at work: lunch, canteen, or a meal card.

benefits.name: Employee discounts
benefits.def: Staff pricing on the company's own products, or a perks platform with third-party discounts.

benefits.name: Unlimited time off
benefits.def: No fixed leave allowance. Read it carefully: unlimited policies often produce less leave taken, not more.

benefits.name: Paid time off
benefits.def: A stated paid leave allowance beyond the statutory minimum.
benefits.unless_near: (public holiday|bank holiday|holiday cover|holiday season|holiday period)|unlimited|open (pto|vacation|holiday)|discretionary time off|take what you need

benefits.name: Paid parental leave
benefits.def: Paid leave for a new parent, beyond the statutory minimum, usually stated in weeks.

benefits.name: Sabbatical
benefits.def: Extended paid or unpaid leave after a qualifying period, usually measured in months.

benefits.name: Four-day week
benefits.def: A compressed or genuinely shortened week: 32 hours, four days, or a nine-day fortnight.

benefits.name: Volunteer days
benefits.def: Paid days off to do charity or community work.

benefits.name: Paid sick leave
benefits.def: Paid absence when you are ill, stated as a policy rather than a statutory floor.

benefits.name: Birthday off
benefits.def: Your birthday as an extra paid day, or a floating personal day.

benefits.name: Flexible hours
benefits.def: You choose when you work, within reason: flexitime, no core hours, or async by default.

benefits.name: Part-time possible
benefits.def: The role can be done at reduced hours, or a job share is on the table.

benefits.name: Visa sponsorship
benefits.def: The employer will sponsor a work permit. Only counted when the posting never declines it.

benefits.name: Work from abroad
benefits.def: A stated allowance of days working from another country each year.

benefits.name: Childcare support
benefits.def: Nursery places, a childcare allowance, or back-up care when arrangements fail.

benefits.name: Fertility support
benefits.def: Cover for fertility treatment, egg freezing, surrogacy, or adoption costs.

benefits.name: Carer's leave
benefits.def: Paid time to care for a dependent adult, or bereavement leave beyond the statutory minimum.

benefits.name: Pet friendly
benefits.def: Dogs in the office, or a pet insurance contribution.

benefits.name: Learning budget
benefits.def: A stated annual sum for courses, books, and training you choose.

benefits.name: Conference budget
benefits.def: Paid attendance at industry conferences, sometimes with speaking support.

benefits.name: Certification support
benefits.def: Exam fees, study leave, and materials for a professional credential.

benefits.name: Mentorship
benefits.def: A named mentor, structured buddy scheme, or paid coaching.

benefits.name: Career framework
benefits.def: A published progression ladder with levels and criteria, rather than ad-hoc promotion.

benefits.name: Equipment of your choice
benefits.def: You pick the machine and peripherals, rather than taking the standard issue.

benefits.name: Team retreats
benefits.def: Company-paid offsites, usually annual, often somewhere the team flies to.

benefits.name: Central office
benefits.def: A specific, stated office quality: central location, roof terrace, showers, quiet rooms.

benefits.name: Drinks and snacks
benefits.def: Coffee, drinks, and snacks provided at the office. The smallest perk that postings still list.

benefits.name: Referral bonus
benefits.def: A payment for introducing someone the company then hires.

benefits.name: Share purchase plan
benefits.def: Buying company stock at a discount through payroll.

benefits.name: Extra insurance
benefits.def: Additional cover the employer pays for: accident, travel, legal, or supplementary health.
